name: 2024 03 06 March PC Meeting Agenda Page
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
March 6, 2024 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute approval for February 7, 2024, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A Public Hearing to consider an application by Ricardo
  Zuniga-Ponce for Special Use Permit No. 23-00025 (SUP23-
  00025) to allow the sale of beer and wine for off-site
  consumption from an existing market within a multi-tenant
  building on an approximately 4,700 square-foot, C-N
  (Neighborhood Commercial) zoned property at 739 East Hyde
  Park Boulevard.
  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-006;
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP23-00025, subject
  to 27 conditions and/or additional conditions as deemed
  appropriate.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A Public Hearing to consider an application by Alex Tsaturov
  representing Morrison Hershfield for Special Use Permit No. 23-
  00035 (SUP23-00035) to allow the location of a 75-foot high,
  wireless telecommunication facility (mono-eucalyptus) on a site
  developed with an existing shopping center on a 30,940 square-
  foot, C-2 (General Commercial) zoned property at 3111 West
  Century Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-023; and
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP23-00035, subject
  to 23 conditions and/or additional conditions as deemed
  appropriate.
  Item 6b Documents

7.  NON-PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. One year review and assessment of SP-2020-004 approved on
  August 5, 2020 to allow 1) the on-site consumption of beer
  and wine and distilled spirits, 2) outdoor dining, and 3)
  outdoor live entertainment within a hotel, hotel restaurant,
  and hotel pool lounge on an approximately 86,102 square-
  foot, M-1L (Limited Manufacturing) zoned property at 3900
  West Century Boulevard.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Affirm the approval of Resolution No. 1877 dated August 5,
  2020; and
  2) Approve with additional conditions to Resolution No. 1877; or
  3) Revoke SP-2020-004
  Item 7a Documents
   b. Final Tract Map to allow a 20-unit residential subdivision on
  a 28,343 square-foot R/3/P-1 (Multiple-Family Residential/
  Automobile Parking) zoned property.

  Preliminary Recommendations:
  1) Recommend the approval of Final Tract Map No. 82105 to the City
  Council subject to 6 conditions.
  Item 7b Documents

8.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

9.  Commission Initiatives.

10.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting March 6, 2024, is not
held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 3, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
